name: How long does a typical full renovation take for a rental property?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical full renovation take for a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full renovation for a rental property can vary significantly based on the scope and complexity of the project. A cosmetic refresh involving paint, flooring, and minor updates might take 2-4 weeks. A more extensive renovation including kitchen and bathroom remodels, or minor structural changes, could range from 6-12 weeks. Major overhauls or additions might extend to several months. Factors like permit approval times, material availability, and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary by scope: cosmetic updates can take 2-4 weeks, while extensive remodels might require 6-12 weeks or more for major overhauls.
